Name: Configurable Regrowth Time
Author: LillieVela
Description:
This is my first mod, and i decided to do something simple: Make it possible to change how long it takes for a crop to produce again


This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. This mod changes the regrowth time based on the highest and lowest amount of days for the regrowable crops (1 through 7). This mod will only affect newly planted crops.

I haven't played Stardew Valley since 1.5 dropped so i can't guarantee this will work with content patcher if it has changed since then.

Downloads.Description: Fixed Strawberry id and removed Tea sapling (which functions differently)
